subject: Aligning Invoicing Cadence & PO Guardrails for Acme Booking Recognition

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning invoicing cadence & PO guardrails for Acme booking recognition

Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Finance asked me to lock in the expected PO timing and a short checklist so our billing team can align invoice issuance with your quarter close. To avoid recognition gaps we typically need:

- Signed PO received at least 10 business days before the invoice date we’ll map to booking recognition.
- A clear effective start date on the PO (month/day).
- Any payment terms that differ from Net 30 flagged in the PO so we can escalate for approval.

I attached a brief mutual action plan with proposed dates and a copy of our standard PO template for your procurement team to use. Can you confirm:
1) Who will be the AP contact receiving the invoice?
2) Target PO submission date (DD/MM/YYYY) to hit July recognition?

If you prefer, we can add a short buffer and schedule the invoice for the 20th of the month to match most mid-market processes.

Thanks — I’ll loop in accounting once you confirm the contact and timing.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: 2027-06-24_acme_mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Subject: Re: Aligning invoicing cadence & PO guardrails for Acme booking recognition

Olga —

Thanks for the clear note. Quick answers below:

1) AP contact: Priya Shah (pri..@acme.com) — she is CC'd on this reply.
2) We’re targeting a PO submission by 2027-07-01 to align with our July close.

We may need the PO to show a July 1 effective date. Also, procurement prefers the invoice date to be between the 5th–10th of the month to hit our internal cutoffs. Can Redwood issue the invoice on July 7 if the PO arrives on July 1?

I’ll have procurement push your PO template through; I expect a signed copy by EOD June 30.

Best,
Jordan

Acme Corp
